# KodRish Innovation & Solutions
> Digital Service Provider

## About
KodRish Innovation & Solutions is a leading technology agency that delivers high-performance web development, intuitive UI/UX design, cutting-edge AI/ML solutions, and scalable cloud services. We specialize in transforming complex technology into seamless digital experiences for startups and enterprises.

## Core Capabilities
- Web & App Development (React, Next.js, Node.js)
- UI/UX Design (Figma, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion)
- AI & Machine Learning (Python, FastAPI, OpenAI Integration)
- Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, Vercel, MongoDB, PostgreSQL)
- Data Analytics (Power BI)
